documents.title: Voting Results Along With Scrutiniser''s Report Of The 44Th Annual General Meeting Held On 18Th September, 2026
Shareholder Meeting / Postal Ballot-Outcome of AGM
Submission Of Notice Of 44Th Annual General Meeting (AGM) For The Financial Year 2025-2026.

analysis.summary: Vidya Wires reported strong operational and financial performance for FY26, with revenue growing 24.2% to 18,396.4 million and EBITDA reaching 857.8 million. The company successfully completed its IPO in December 2025 and commenced manufacturing at its new ALCU Industries facility on February 7, 2026, marking a significant step toward expanding capacity and moving up the value chain into specialized product segments like EV infrastructure and renewable energy. Management anticipates robust volume growth and margin improvement for FY27 as the new capacities ramp up fully by around September or October. Furthermore, the company remains insulated from base metal volatility through a strict back-to-back hedging policy for copper and aluminium. Vidya Wires Limited presented its Q3 and nine-month FY26 operational and financial performance, highlighting robust revenue and profit growth.

guidance.claim: The company expects to operate at 100% capacity planned in ALCU by September or October or before Diwali.
guidance.quote: and the remaining 8, 000 to 9,000 tons or so will be added over a period of around September or October or before Diwali we are expecting to operate at 100% capacity planned in ALCU.

guidance.claim: By Diwali, the company's total capacity will be close to 35,000 to 36,000 metric tons.
guidance.quote: So we will be close to -- by Diwali we will be close to 35,00, 36,000 metric tons of capacity, which was planned.

guidance.claim: Management anticipates good strong volume growth in the coming time.
guidance.quote: Yes, definitely. We anticipate a good strong volume growth in the coming time.

guidance.claim: The company expects to utilize around 55% to 60% of the new capacity next year.
guidance.quote: So, the next year we see that new capacity will come up and we are looking around 55% to 60% of that capacity should be able to utilize.

demand_outlook.claim: Industry research indicates a rebound in India's power demand growth to 5% to 5.5% range.
demand_outlook.quote: Industry research indicates a rebound in India's power demand growth to 5% to 5.5% range, driven by data centers, industrial consumption and the ongoing energy transition.

demand_outlook.claim: Power and transmission segment currently stands around 51% of the business.
demand_outlook.quote: So the segment-wise if we see, currently we are around 51% in the basically power and transmission segment.

demand_outlook.claim: Renewable and EV segment is around 7% or so.
demand_outlook.quote: The renewable and EV is around 7% or so.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that the Indian winding and conductivity products market stands at approximately 3.43 lakh metric tons.
demand_outlook.quote: The Indian winding and conductivity products market stands at approximately 3.43 lakh metric tons.

demand_outlook.claim: India's power generation capacity is expected to more than double from 442 gigawatt in 2024 to approximately 900 gigawatt by 2032.
demand_outlook.quote: Today, the generation capacity is expected to more than double from 442 gigawatt in 2024 to approximately 900 gigawatt by 2032.

demand_outlook.claim: Solar capacity is expected to reach 365 gigawatt by FY2032 growing at a 14.5% CAGR.
demand_outlook.quote: Solar capacity is expected to reach 365 gigawatt by FY2032 growing at a 14.5% CAGR.

capex_expansion.claim: Manufacturing at ALCU Industries commenced on February 7th, 2026.
capex_expansion.quote: While we have commenced manufacturing on February 7th, 2026, I want to emphasize that we are currently in a phased ramp-up period.

capex_expansion.claim: The company added some 6,000 metric tons of capacity in the new plant.
capex_expansion.quote: So currently, I mean we are already we have added some 6,000 metric tons of capacity and the remaining 8, 000 to 9,000 tons or so will be added over a period of around September or October or before Diwali we are expecting to operate at 100% capacity planned in ALCU.

capex_expansion.claim: ALCU Industries produced approximately 800 metric tons of volume in its initial phase.
capex_expansion.quote: So basically, in February mid only, I mean the first week only we have started and we have done some 800 metric tons approximately volume from ALCU Industries.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is nearly doubling its manufacturing capacity from 19680 metric tons per annum to 37680 metric tons per annum through its new facility Narsanda via its subsidiary ALCU Industries.
capex_expansion.quote: We are nearly doubling our manufacturing capacity from 19680 metric tons per annum to 37680 metric tons per annum through our new facility Narsanda via our subsidiary called as ALCU Industries.

capex_expansion.claim: Out of the IPO proceeds, Rs. 140 Crores is allocated for capital expenditure at ALCU Industries.
capex_expansion.quote: On IPO proceeds, as committed we are prudently deploying the fresh issue funds our IPO raised Rs.274 Crores, Rs. 140 Crores is allocated for capital expenditure at ALCU Industries; this will nearly double our capacity to 37,680 metric tons and enable new product lines.

capex_expansion.claim: Construction of the new facility has completed more than 75% to 80% and operations are expected to start soon in the last quarter.
capex_expansion.quote: So we have probably completed more than 75% to 80 % of our construction and we believe in the last quarter, we will start our operations very soon.

margins_costs.claim: For FY26, EBITDA reached 857.8 million with a margin of 4.66%.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA reached 857.8 million with a margin of 4.66, an increase of 35 basis points year-over-year improvement.

margins_costs.claim: The company maintains a strict back-to-back hedging policy for copper and aluminium procurement to protect margins.
margins_costs.quote: To protect our margins, we have continued our strict back-to-back hedging policy for copper and aluminium procurement.

margins_costs.claim: Gross Profit for Q3 FY26 was Rs 355.13 million with a gross profit margin of 7.92%.
H1 FY2026 EBITDA without other income grew by 19% to Rs. 34 Crores with EBITDA margin increasing to 4.3%.
margins_costs.quote: H1 FY2026 EBITDA without other income grew by 19% to Rs. 34 Crores. The EBITDA margin increased to 4.3% an improvement of 50 basis points.

margins_costs.claim: Approximately 26% of power requirements are sourced from renewable energy through own solar and windmill installations, providing cost stability.
margins_costs.quote: I am also happy to share that approximately 26% of our power requirements are sourced from renewable energy through our own solar and windmill installations. Sustainable manufacturing is not just good for environment but also provides us the cost stability.

orders_capacity.claim: Total volume for FY26 was around 18,024 metric tons.
orders_capacity.quote: No, volume will be around 18,024 metric tons.

orders_capacity.claim: The company operates with a diverse portfolio comprising 8,500+ SKUs.
Vidya Wires is the fourth largest player in the Indian winding and conductivity product industry with a 5.7% market share.
orders_capacity.quote: Today, Vidya Wires is the fourth largest player in the Indian winding and conductivity product industry with a 5.7% market share.

orders_capacity.claim: Current capacity utilization is on an average 90% or so.
orders_capacity.quote: So, currently our capacity is in like on an average 90% or so we are already utilizing it

capital_allocation.claim: The company utilized INR100 crores to repay working capital borrowings.
capital_allocation.quote: In line with our commitment to a lean balance sheet, we have utilized INR100 crores to repay our working capital borrowings, successfully reducing our interest burden and strengthening our credit profile.

capital_allocation.claim: A significant portion of IPO proceeds has been deployed to fund capital expenditure for ALCU Industries.
capital_allocation.quote: We have deployed a significant portion of IPO proceeds to the fund the capital expenditure required for expansion of ALCU Industries.

capital_allocation.claim: Rs 1,000 million is allocated for loan repayment or prepayment to reduce the interest burden.
capital_allocation.quote: ₹1,000 million allocated for loan repayment/prepayment to reduce interest burden.

capital_allocation.claim: Rs. 100 Crores from the IPO proceeds is allocated for repayment of borrowings.
capital_allocation.quote: Rs.100 Crores is for repayment of borrowings. This will reduce leverage, lower finance cost and improve our debt equity ratio.

management_commitments.claim: The company targets to reach a balance of 75% domestic and 25% export in its revenue mix.
management_commitments.quote: Yes, we are definitely targeting the international market and our target is that we should have a balance of 75% domestic and 25% export.

management_commitments.claim: Management plans to reduce debtor collection days down to around 35 days.
management_commitments.quote: Currently, we are at 41 days of debtors as of now, and we can definitely bring it down to around 35 days.

management_commitments.claim: Financial year 2027 will be the first full year realizing the consolidated benefits of expanded capacity.
management_commitments.quote: For Vidya Wires, financial year 27 will be the first full year where we hopefully realize the consolidated benefits of our expanded capacity.

management_commitments.claim: India targets 500 GW non-fossil capacity by 2030.
management_commitments.quote: India targets 500 GW non-fossil capacity by 2030 (CareEdge Report)

management_commitments.claim: Management stated that next financial year the company will hopefully have positive operating cash flows.
management_commitments.quote: So next financial year, hopefully, we'll have a positive operating cash flows.

management_commitments.claim: Operations at the new facility are planned to start in the final quarter of the year.
management_commitments.quote: just like discussed in the final quarter of this year, we are planning to start the new facility and that would definitely add more utilization in the sense in absolute numbers, the capacity will actually go up.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
